page.overview:
What is Mimikyu?

The overall structure of the disguise resembles Pikachu, though the body is triangular with no limbs, a small portion of the disguise does not cover the real Mimikyu underneath. The disguise is made of cloth, with 2 holes for eyes in the body of the costume, which are the actual eyes of Mimikyu. it has very crooked ears and the skin is a grayish-beige color. Its "tail" is made of wood and has a grayish-brown color. The disguise's "face" only consists of poorly drawn eyes, cheeks, and a zigzag mouth.

Underneath the cloth appears to be a black shadowy mass with two glowing eyes, but it is unknown what it looks like in full, as glimpsing it causes immediate catatonic shock, if not death. In actuality, Mimikyu is only approximately the size of its disguise's torso, as there appears to be nothing organic inside of the rag's head.thumb|official concept art revealing mimikyu in 2024

Shiny Mimikyu's disguise turns completely gray. Its "tail" and eyes remain unchanged.

Due to its clothed appearance, it was previously mistaken as an ordinary ghost in ragged cloth until it was recently identified as a Pokémon species.
